data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'Oda', meaning 'wealthy, prosperous'. The name Odell may also be derived from the Old English word 'oda', meaning 'fighter'. In Christian tradition, this name is believed to represent strength and prosperity. The name Odell carries the meaning “Fighter, Wealthy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Odell usually hope their child will grow to embody fighter, wealthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Odell total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
